name: io.github.urlbox/screenshot-mcp-server
title: Urlbox
description: Screenshots, PDFs, video, markdown and page data from any website, via Urlbox.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional if your client signs in with OAuth. Otherwise 'Bearer <key>' with a Urlbox organisation API key or project secret key.

environmentVariables.name: URLBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Urlbox organisation API key (all tools) or project secret key (rendering tools).

environmentVariables.name: URLBOX_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where save_render saves files. Defaults to ~/Downloads.
